distributed_file.modification: FaceLogin static per-tensor QDQ INT8 quantization, using tools/threshold_calibration/quantize_r50.py

original_download.evidence: Hugging Face LFS metadata reports this file size and SHA-256. The repository contains only .gitattributes and the model, with no model card or license file.

upstream_policy.associated_model_family: ResNet50@WebFace600K, used in buffalo_l and buffalo_m
upstream_policy.family_association_basis: FaceLogin's existing model preparation records, model filename and upstream Model Zoo family descriptions; no byte-for-byte comparison against an official model pack was performed in this check.
upstream_policy.visible_weight_terms: Non-commercial research purposes only; MIT applies to the upstream library code, not these pretrained weights.

authorization.selected_route: Keep the existing model and request written authorization from the rights holder.
required_scope: Offline Windows desktop login/unlock authentication, including ordinary non-research use
ONNX conversion and static QDQ INT8 derivative weights
Redistribution of the approved weights and derivatives in downloadable installers and installation onto recipients' computers
Permitted use by recipients of the freely distributed open-source application
Applicable attribution, license notices, deployment limits, duration and fees
authorization.artifact_confirmation_required: Ask InsightFace to identify whether the mirrored FP32 hash is covered, or provide the official artifact/hash to which its written grant applies.
authorization.completion_evidence: A written grant or agreement identifying the licensee, approved artifact and derivative, authentication use, redistribution/end-user rights and any conditions. A contact address, sent inquiry, quote or technical compatibility check is not approval.
